::: {#rem-conditional-phrasings}
#### English phrasings of $P \Rightarrow Q$

Each of these sentences means $P \Rightarrow Q$:

- If $P$, then $Q$.
- $Q$ if $P$.
- $Q$ whenever $P$.
- $Q$, provided that $P$.
- Whenever $P$, then also $Q$.
- $P$ is a sufficient condition for $Q$.
- For $Q$, it is sufficient that $P$.
- $Q$ is a necessary condition for $P$.
- For $P$, it is necessary that $Q$.
- $P$ only if $Q$.

:::
